mapper.select: SELECT c.code, c.title AS name FROM CHALLENGE AS c WHERE c.delete_yn = 0
SELECT c.code, c.title AS name FROM CHALLENGE AS c WHERE c.progress_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND c.post_status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.delete_yn = 0

SELECT main_category.code, main_category.name, sub_category.sub_category_code AS sub_code, sub_category.sub_category_name AS sub_name FROM MARKET_CATEGORY AS main_category
JOIN ( SELECT sub.code AS sub_category_code, sub.main_cate AS main_category_code, sub.name AS sub_category_name FROM MARKET_CATEGORY AS sub WHERE sub.delete_yn = 0 AND sub.status = 'active' AND sub.main_cate IS NOT NULL ) AS sub_category ON main_category.code = sub_category.main_category_code WHERE main_category.status = 'active' AND main_category.delete_yn = 0

SELECT main_category.code, main_category.name, main_category.status, main_category.delete_yn, sub_category.sub_category_code AS sub_code, sub_category.sub_category_name AS sub_name, sub_category.sub_category_status AS sub_status, sub_category.sub_category_delete_yn AS sub_delete_yn FROM MARKET_CATEGORY AS main_category
JOIN ( SELECT sub.code AS sub_category_code, sub.main_cate AS main_category_code, sub.name AS sub_category_name, sub.status AS sub_category_status, sub.delete_yn AS sub_category_delete_yn FROM MARKET_CATEGORY AS sub WHERE sub.main_cate IS NOT NULL ) AS sub_category ON main_category.code = sub_category.main_category_code
